meta.title: Ivory & Ink — Studio folio 2027
meta.description: Credentials deck for Ivory & Ink, a book and report design studio: point of view, three rules, three cases with results (an annual report, an art monograph, a one-colour identity), clients and process.

slides.eyebrow: Ivory & Ink · Book and report design · Folio 2027
slides.heading: We design books and reports people keep on the shelf.
slides.lead: A studio of six in Edinburgh. 140 titles since 2016.
